issues.description: The problem statement (UML and description) requires SealSaloon.calculateTotalPrice(Meal) to return a double (for double precision financial calculations), but the implemented method in the solution repository is declared to return an int. This mismatch between the specified return type (double) and the actual implementation (int) can confuse students about the expected API and precision and may cause failures if tests expect a double.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the calculateTotalPrice method signature match the problem specification by returning a double. Update the implementation to use a double accumulator (e.g., double sum = 0.0) and return a double. Alternatively, if integer prices were intentional, update the problem statement/UML to specify an int return type and remove the reference to double precision so both spec and implementation align.
